Boreal

Paper birch bark is rich in betulin, a white waxy compound that makes it waterproof and rot resistant; it was used for canoes, containers and roofing across the boreal forest.

Source: Safford, Bjorkbom & Zasada 1990, Betula papyrifera, in Silvics of North America vol. 2
